(rule! (let ((dummy 0))
  (define (frame-border r0 c0 r1 c1)
    (for*/list ((r (in-range r0 (+ r1 1)))
                (c (in-range c0 (+ c1 1)))
                #:when (or (= r r0) (= r r1) (= c c0) (= c c1)))
      (list r c)))
  (define (gravity grid)
    (for/fold ((out (empty-grid (rows grid) (cols grid) 0)))
              ((box (in-list (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 5))
                                     (objects grid 0)))))
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox box))
             (r0 (first bb)) (c0 (second bb))
             (r1 (third bb)) (c1 (fourth bb)))
        (for/fold ((acc (paint-cells out (frame-border r0 c0 r1 c1) 5)))
                  ((c (in-range (+ c0 1) c1)))
          (let ((vals (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0)))
                              (map (lambda (r) (at grid r c))
                                   (range (+ r0 1) r1)))))
            (for/fold ((acc2 acc))
                      ((v (in-list (reverse vals)))
                       (i (in-range (length vals))))
              (set-cell acc2 (- r1 1 i) c v)))))))
  (let* ((stage-a (gravity g))
         (payload (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 2))
                          (objects stage-a 0)))
         (target (argmax obj-size payload)))
    (paint-cells stage-a (obj-cells target) 9))))
